title: A lock file we cannot permanently read (EACCES on an existing lock) now surfaces as conflict after the wait budget, not io-error
evidence: Delete-pending locks make the read of the lock fail with EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES as well as the create (observed: the flake persisted after create-only handling; failing op was 'EPERM open job-queue.lock' from the read). Both are now contention, so a lock file with a genuinely unreadable ACL reports a typed conflict after lockWaitMs (default 2 s) instead of io-error. Bounded, nothing written, queue file/dir permission errors still io-error.
fix_direction: None needed unless operators need the distinction; could add the last errno to the conflict message.
